summary: Frontend-only testing of brand filtering features on Optowire Angular SSR catalog app. All 6 required features verified and passing. Home page brands: logos shown at w-28 h-28, no brand name labels, no Browse buttons. Catalog: 1146 products shown initially, brands sidebar visible without category selected. URL brand param /catalog?brand=34 shows 157 Vivio products with Vivio checkbox checked. Sidebar brand checkbox click filters server-side to 157 Vivio products. Home page brand card click navigates to /catalog?brand=34 and shows 157 products.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 - external API endpoint not supported. Non-blocking, no UI impact.

critical_code_review_comments: MINOR: /api/ext/web/promotional-unit?customerId=0 returns 500 on every home page load. This is the external API returning an error - backend proxy may want to swallow this error or frontend can handle gracefully. Not blocking current feature set.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App at catalog-proxy-fix.preview.emergentagent.com. Angular SSR. Brands: Yixing(id=3), Vivio(id=34), Optowire(id=4). All brand filtering features verified. Catalog without category shows 1146 products + brand sidebar. /catalog?brand=34 = 157 Vivio results. Home page brand cards link to /catalog?brand=ID. Minor: promotional-unit API returns 500 (non-critical).
